discription: A rich, detuned saw wave sound with a standard ADSR envelope, created by layering two slightly detuned saw oscillators.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=0.005; var sig1, sig2, sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig1 = Saw.ar(freq); sig2 = Saw.ar(freq * (1 + detune)); sig = (sig1 + sig2) * 0.5 * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
